title: Smart Data Models - Project Haystack - Site
description: Site is a geographic location of the built environment. Typically site maps to one building with its own unique street address. See the Haystack 'Sites' chapter chapter. (Project Haystack 4.0.0 entity 'site', Xeto spec ph::Site. Tag names verbatim; marker tags in hasTag.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity. Stands for the Haystack 'id' Ref tag.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Site'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasTag.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/ph/4.0.0#hasTag'. The marker tags of the entity, verbatim Haystack tag names, as Haystack's own RDF export encodes markers (ph:hasTag). Must contain 'site'. It carries the entity subtype markers (e.g. site), the options chosen for Haystack choices and any other marker such as his, cur, writable or hvac. Values expand to the Haystack def IRIs in JSON-LD. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/docHaystack/Rdf#instances

dis.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/ph/4.0.0#dis'. Display name for an entity. See the Haystack 'Ontology' chapter chapter. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-ph/dis

area.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#area'. Area of a shape or floor space. Units:'m²'. (Haystack Numbers carry their own unit; prefUnit ft², m². Smart Data Models fixes the SI unit.) Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/area

geoAddr.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/ph/4.0.0#geoAddr'. Free form street address. Best practice is to follow local norms for a postal address. Typically this string includes the 'geoStreet', 'geoCity', 'geoState' (in US), and 'geoPostalCode': Examples: "1600 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20500" "10 Downing St, Westminster, London SW1A 2AA, United Kingdom" "Champ de Mars, 5 Avenue Anatole France, 75007 Paris, France". Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-ph/geoAddr

geoCity.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/ph/4.0.0#geoCity'. Geographic city or locality name. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-ph/geoCity

geoCoord.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/ph/4.0.0#geoCoord'. Geographic coordinate as 'C(latitude,longitude)'. Encoded as in Haystack JSON (Hayson): an object with lat and lng. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-ph/geoCoord

geoCounty.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/ph/4.0.0#geoCounty'. Geographic subdivision of US state. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-ph/geoCounty

geoElevation.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/ph/4.0.0#geoElevation'. Elevation above sea-level of the location. Units:'m'. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-ph/geoElevation

geoPostalCode.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/ph/4.0.0#geoPostalCode'. Geographic postal code; for US this is a five digit zip code. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-ph/geoPostalCode

geoState.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/ph/4.0.0#geoState'. State or province name; for US this is two letter state code. May be used in other countries to model administrative area between the geoCity and geoCountry level. tz.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/ph/4.0.0#tz'. Timezone identifier from standard timezone database. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-ph/tz

weatherStationRef.description: Relationship. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#weatherStationRef'. Reference to weather station for to use this entity. Points to a WeatherStation entity. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/weatherStationRef

yearBuilt.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#yearBuilt'. Original year of construction as four digit year such as 1980. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/yearBuilt

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Not a Haystack tag (Smart Data Models addition): GeoJSON Point [longitude, latitude] built from geoCoord, so that NGSI-LD geo-queries work.

marker.description: Haystack marker tags (non-conjunct marker defs of Haystack 4.0.0).
